focus.zh: 台灣與東南亞半導體設備材料、伺服器機櫃與電源、晶圓封測及海外工廠投資
focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asian semiconductor tools and materials, server racks and power, wafer testing and foreign factory investment

throughline.zh: 鴻海公布 AI 伺服器帶動的第三季財報，南亞與三福化核准台灣電子材料擴產，三井金屬宣布馬來西亞銅箔新廠，馬來西亞亦研議資料中心晶片監管。
throughline.en: Foxconn reported server-driven Q3 results, Nanya and San Fu approved Taiwanese electronic-materials expansion, Mitsui announced a Malaysian copper-foil plant, and Malaysia considered new data-center chip oversight.

text.zh: 鴻海第三季營收約 3.02 兆元、年增 46%，雲端網路占 54%，機櫃未來出貨成長仍為管理層預測。
text.en: Foxconn recorded about NT$3.02T Q3 sales, up 46% YoY, with cloud and networking at 54%; future rack growth is guidance.

text.zh: 南亞核准彰濱玻纖布第五廠 115.3 億元，規劃年產 1 億公尺，尚未量產。
text.en: Nanya Plastics approved NT$11.53B for its fifth fiberglass fabric plant, targeting 100M meters annually before commissioning.

text.zh: 馬來西亞研議要求資料中心揭露營運商、場址與 GPU 引進量，尚未立法。
text.en: Malaysia is considering facility reporting of operators, sites and imported GPU counts; no new law is enacted.

text.zh: 三井金屬 11 月 10 日核准馬來西亞 1,900 億日圓銅箔新廠，預計 2031 年分期營運。
text.en: Mitsui Kinzoku approved a JPY190B Malaysia copper-foil plant on Nov 10, targeting phased operation from 2031.

text.zh: 三福化核准橋頭科學園區先進封裝化學品廠最高 15 億元資本支出。
text.en: San Fu approved up to NT$1.5B for an advanced-packaging chemicals facility at Qiaotou.

title.zh: 鴻海第三季營收約 3.02 兆元，雲端網路占比 54%，上調四大事業全年展望
title.en: Foxconn Q3 revenue reaches NT$3.02T, cloud and networking at 54%, with full-year segment outlooks raised

summary.zh: 鴻海 11 月 12 日公布第三季合併營收約 3.02 兆元、年增 46%，歸屬母公司淨利約 775.24 億元、年增 34%；雲端網路產品占營收 54%，較第二季增加 3 個百分點。公司上修全年四大產品線的展望，預估第四季及 2027 年 AI 機櫃出貨維持高雙位數成長，但未公布實際機櫃件數或各產品營收。
summary.en: Foxconn reported Q3 consolidated revenue of about NT$3.02 trillion on November 12, up 46% YoY, and attributable net profit of approximately NT$77.524 billion, up 34%. Cloud and networking products represented 54% of revenue, three percentage points above Q2. Management upgraded its full-year outlook for all four segments and forecast high-double-digit AI-rack shipment growth in Q4 and 2027, without actual rack units.

text.zh: 鴻海雲端網路事業包括 AI 與通用型伺服器、機櫃及網通設備，集團並經營手機、電腦及零組件。雲端網路占比屬事業群營收比例，未直接揭露電源供應器、液冷設備、GPU 機櫃或個別客戶出貨。
text.en: Foxconn's cloud and networking group includes AI and general-purpose servers, racks and network systems alongside separate consumer and computing businesses. Segment mix is consolidated revenue share rather than stand-alone power supplies, liquid-cooling hardware or GPU-rack shipments.

text.zh: 鴻海原始新聞稿列出第三季營收約 3.02 兆元、毛利 1,815 億元、營業利益 1,154 億元、歸屬母公司淨利約 775 億元，毛利率、營益率、淨利率依序為 6.02%、3.83%、2.57%。中央社詳表列第三季營收 3 兆 156.34 億元、歸屬母公司淨利 775.24 億元；前九月營收 7 兆 6,610.62 億元、歸屬母公司淨利 1,874.17 億元。公司稱目前晶片、記憶體等供應吃緊，2027 年仍是展望而非已驗收需求。
text.en: The company's release gives Q3 revenue of approximately NT$3.02 trillion, gross profit NT$181.5 billion, operating profit NT$115.4 billion, and attributable profit about NT$77.5 billion; gross, operating and net margins were 6.02%, 3.83% and 2.57%. CNA's detailed figures report NT$3,015.634 billion Q3 revenue and NT$77.524 billion net profit; nine-month figures were NT$7,661.062 billion and NT$187.417 billion. Management cited tight chips and memory supply, while 2027 rack growth remains a forecast.

text.zh: 第四季 AI 機櫃實際出貨台數、獨立機櫃營收、電源與冷卻規格、客戶驗收以及 2027 年已簽訂數量未公布。
text.en: Q4 AI rack units, stand-alone rack revenue, power and cooling specifications, customer acceptance and firm 2027 contracts were not disclosed.

title.zh: 南亞核准彰濱玻纖布第五廠 115.3 億元投資，規劃年產 1 億公尺
title.en: Nanya Plastics approves NT$11.53B Changbin fiberglass-fabric plant, targeting 100M meters annually

summary.zh: 南亞塑膠 11 月 11 日董事會核准在彰化縣彰濱廠區興建玻纖布第五廠，預計投入 115.3 億元，規劃年產 1 億公尺、月產約 800 萬至 900 萬公尺的薄布與超薄布。公司另核准對上游特殊玻纖紗子公司台灣必成增資 8 億元，屬另一資金安排；未公布第五廠量產日期。
summary.en: Nanya Plastics approved NT$11.53 billion on November 11 for its fifth fiberglass-fabric plant at the Changbin site in Changhua. The proposed line targets 100 million meters annually, or roughly eight to nine million meters monthly, of thin and ultra-thin fabric. A separate NT$800 million capital increase for upstream fiberglass-yarn subsidiary Taiwan Bischeng was also announced, without a commissioning date.

text.zh: 電子級玻纖紗為玻纖布上游材料，玻纖布用於銅箔基板與多層印刷電路板，應用延伸至伺服器、網通及工業電子。公司既有四座台灣玻纖布廠位於嘉義新港，新廠將位於彰濱園區，不能把規劃容量視為既有產能。
text.en: Electronic-grade fiberglass yarn supplies woven fabric used in copper-clad laminates and multilayer PCBs for servers, networking and industrial electronics. Nanya's existing four Taiwan fabric plants are in Xingang, Chiayi; the new Changbin plant's planned capacity is not current output.

text.zh: 中央社 11 月 12 日報導董事會前日核准的 115.3 億元建廠投資，年產 1 億公尺是公司計畫，月產 800 萬至 900 萬公尺為約數。台灣必成擬擴充 T 紗特殊級玻纖紗產能，8 億元為子公司資本增資；南亞另提及未來銅箔基板新產能規劃，但尚無本次核准的獨立 CCL 投資數。
text.en: CNA reported the November 11 board approval on November 12. The 100-million-meter annual capacity is a company plan and the eight-to-nine-million-meter monthly target is approximate. The NT$800 million subsidiary capitalization supports planned specialty T-yarn capacity; prospective copper-clad laminate expansion has no separate new approved amount here.

text.zh: 新廠實際土建進度、量產年份、各產品驗收、薄布與超薄布的比重，以及 8 億元增資和建廠預算的資金重疊範圍未揭露。
text.en: Construction milestones, commissioning year, customer acceptance, thin versus ultra-thin mix and possible funding overlap between the factory and subsidiary capital are undisclosed.

title.zh: 馬來西亞研議立法監管資料中心營運，擬要求揭露 GPU 數量與業者資訊
title.en: Malaysia considers data-center monitoring law covering GPU counts, operators and locations

summary.zh: 馬來西亞投資、貿易及工業部長 Johari Abdul Ghani 11 月 12 日表示，政府正研議立法，要求規劃建設資料中心者提供營運商、場址與預計引進的 GPU 數量，以監測高效能晶片使用及轉運情況。路透社引述部長發言指出，目前仍屬政策構想，沒有正式法案條文、申報期限或已生效的新限制。
summary.en: On November 12, Malaysian Investment, Trade and Industry Minister Johari Abdul Ghani said the government is considering legislation requiring prospective data-center developers to disclose operators, locations and the number of GPUs being imported. Reuters reported the proposal as a potential means of monitoring high-performance chip use and re-export; no enacted law, filing deadline or finalized reporting template was announced.

text.zh: 馬來西亞資料中心建設涉及當地供電、冷卻與伺服器機櫃整合，部分設備和晶片供應鏈與台灣 ODM 廠商相連。馬來西亞在 2025 年已對部分美國來源高效能 AI 晶片的流動建立出口管制，該既有措施與本次尚未完成的資料中心監測法構想應分開。
text.en: Malaysia's data-center development involves site electricity, cooling and server systems supplied through international chains that include Taiwanese ODMs. Malaysia had already imposed controls in 2025 on certain US-origin high-performance AI chips; that existing measure is distinct from this proposed facility-reporting law.

text.zh: 路透社於 11 月 12 日報導，Johari 在部會活動指出，規劃興建機房者可能需要揭露營運商、地點及 GPU 引進量，並強調受美國限制的晶片應按合法用途進口與使用。報導提及針對個別公司的指控與當事公司否認違規的回應，相關個案沒有已證實判決，不應將質疑延伸為全體業者的事實。
text.en: Reuters reported the minister's November 12 statement on potential facility filings covering developers, site locations and GPU quantities, emphasizing compliant import use of restricted chips. The report also mentioned allegations concerning individual companies and their statements of compliance; no confirmed court finding establishes wrongdoing or applies broadly to all operators.

text.zh: 法案正式文字、適用的晶片型號、現有與新設機房的申報範圍、正式生效日期及個別台灣供應商訂單影響均未揭露。
text.en: Draft text, covered chip models, whether existing sites must report, implementation dates and quantified effects on Taiwanese supplier orders remain unknown.

title.zh: 三井金屬 11 月 10 日核准馬來西亞銅箔新廠，總投資約 1,900 億日圓
title.en: Mitsui Kinzoku approves JPY190B Malaysia copper-foil plant, with phased operation from 2031

summary.zh: 日本三井金屬 11 月 10 日董事會宣布在馬來西亞既有子公司附近興建銅箔廠，投資約 1,900 億日圓，製造 MicroThin 載體超薄銅箔與高頻電路板 VSP 電解銅箔。公司規劃自 2031 年 4 月分階段營運，至 2033 財年 MicroThin 月產能新增 400 萬平方公尺、VSP 於 2032 財年增加每月 1,200 公噸，均為未來規劃。
summary.en: Mitsui Kinzoku's board approved a JPY190 billion copper-foil plant near its existing Malaysian subsidiary on November 10. The facility is planned to produce MicroThin carrier-supported ultra-thin foil and VSP electrodeposited foil for high-frequency boards, with phased operations from April 2031 and planned additions of 4 million square meters per month of MicroThin by FY2033 and 1,200 tonnes per month of VSP by FY2032.

text.zh: 超薄銅箔用於高密度基板與先進電子封裝，高頻電路板用銅箔涉及高速訊號傳輸。馬來西亞新廠與台灣先進封裝載板及伺服器 PCB 材料供應鏈具有產品層級連結，但公告並未列出任何台灣客戶或確定採購合約。
text.en: Ultra-thin copper foil is used in advanced substrates and packaging, while high-frequency board foil supports high-speed signal applications. The Malaysian investment relates to materials used along Taiwan-linked substrate and server PCB chains, though no Taiwanese customer contracts were named.

text.zh: 三井金屬英文官方申報列總投資約 1,900 億日圓，其中土地 140 億、建築 320 億及設備等 1,440 億日圓，三部分合計等於總額，不可額外累加。MicroThin 在 FY2031 新增月產 200 萬平方公尺，FY2033 再增 200 萬；VSP 在 FY2031、FY2032 分別新增月產 600 公噸。2033 財年全球 MicroThin 月產能規劃達 1,200 萬平方公尺，VSP 2032 財年全球月產能達 2,600 公噸，亦包含既有廠產能。
text.en: Mitsui's official English filing allocates the JPY190 billion total across land JPY14 billion, buildings JPY32 billion and equipment/other assets JPY144 billion; these sum to the total and must not be added again. MicroThin would add 2 million square meters per month in FY2031 and another 2 million in FY2033; VSP adds 600 tonnes per month in each of FY2031 and FY2032. The respective group-wide capacity targets of 12 million square meters/month and 2,600 tonnes/month include existing production.

text.zh: 新廠詳細城市與街址、各期客戶認證、實際設備投產、各產品良率與特定台灣下游供應商採購數量尚未公布。
text.en: New factory city and street address, customer qualifications, tool commissioning, yields and procurement volumes for specific Taiwanese downstream suppliers remain unverified.

title.zh: 三福化核准橋頭科學園區先進封裝化學品擴廠，上限 15 億元
title.en: San Fu Chemical approves up to NT$1.5B for advanced-packaging chemicals plant at Qiaotou

summary.zh: 三福化 11 月 11 日董事會核准橋頭科學園區建廠及設備資本支出上限 15 億元，用於先進封裝蝕刻液、剝離劑及相關清洗材料擴產。公司另公布第三季稅後淨利 2.64 億元、年增 176.1%；先前的善化廠 1.5 億元擴充案屬另一時間與工程範圍，橋科新廠仍未正式投產。
summary.en: San Fu Chemical's board approved up to NT$1.5 billion on November 11 for buildings and equipment at Qiaotou Science Park to make chemicals used in advanced-packaging etching, stripping and cleaning. Q3 after-tax profit was NT$264 million, up 176.1% YoY; an earlier NT$150 million Shanhua expansion is a separately dated project, while the Qiaotou plant is not yet in production.

text.zh: 先進封裝化學品用於晶圓、載板或封裝製程的蝕刻與光阻去除等環節，與 CoWoS、InFO 等封裝技術的製程材料需求相連。三福化現有善化廠另擴充光阻剝離材料，不能把橋頭與善化兩個獨立決議的金額視為單一工廠的成本。
text.en: Advanced-packaging chemicals are used for etching, stripping and cleaning across wafer and substrate processes linked to CoWoS and InFO. San Fu has separately dated expansion at Shanhua for stripping materials; it is distinct from the Qiaotou approval.

text.zh: 11 月 11 日公開資訊觀測站重大訊息經台視財經轉載，明列橋科廠房與設備支出不超過 15 億元，付款依訂單條件，並授權董事長議定工程合約。經濟日報 11 月 12 日報導公司前三季歸屬母公司淨利 4.99 億元，10 月營收 4.51 億元；9 月 CoWoS 剝離劑占集團營收約 22% 屬業者在報導中的說法，未直接取得原始分產品月報。
text.en: A reproduction of the November 11 exchange filing explicitly sets the Qiaotou buildings and equipment ceiling at NT$1.5 billion, with payments determined by contracts. Economic Daily News reported nine-month attributable profit of NT$499 million and October sales of NT$451 million. An approximately 22% September sales share for CoWoS stripper is reported by the newspaper but was not checked against a primary product-level filing.

text.zh: 橋科新廠正式交貨、廠務投產、單位化學品月產量、客戶製程認證及實際支出尚未公布。
text.en: Qiaotou construction completion, commissioning, chemical output volumes, customer process qualification and realized expenditure were not announced.

title.zh: 雙鴻第三季營收 97.87 億元，毛利率 25.65%，較第二季減少 2.77 個百分點
title.en: Auras Q3 sales reach NT$9.787B; gross margin falls to 25.65%, down 2.77 percentage points QoQ

summary.zh: 散熱廠雙鴻於 11 月 11 日公布第三季營收 97.87 億元、年增 64.2%，歸屬母公司淨利 10.8 億元、年增 10.9%，每股純益 11.59 元。第三季毛利率為 25.65%，較第二季減少 2.77 個百分點、較去年同期減少 4.12 個百分點；公司先前提及新一代伺服器冷卻產品交付計畫，但未提供本季液冷產品的獨立收入及件數。
summary.en: Cooling supplier Auras reported Q3 revenue of NT$9.787 billion on November 11, up 64.2% YoY, and attributable profit of NT$1.08 billion, up 10.9% YoY, with EPS of NT$11.59. Gross margin was 25.65%, down 2.77 percentage points QoQ and 4.12 points YoY. Earlier new-server cooling guidance does not quantify Q3 liquid-cooling unit shipments.

text.zh: 雙鴻供應伺服器與運算設備散熱模組，產品涵蓋氣冷與液冷相關零組件。第三季營收與獲利增速不同，毛利率因產品組合及新舊平台轉換等因素可能變動，但不能從單季總值證實個別冷卻產品單價下降。
text.en: Auras supplies air- and liquid-cooling modules for computing and servers. Consolidated sales and profit grew at different rates, and product mix can affect margins, but the quarterly figures alone do not establish falling prices for a specific cooling product.

text.zh: 中央社 11 月 11 日報導第三季營收 97.87 億元、母公司淨利 10.8 億元，毛利率 25.65%，年減 4.12、季減 2.77 個百分點。前三季母公司淨利 32.13 億元、年增 95.6%；先前管理階層對年底新平台出貨及 2027 年初延續需求的陳述是預測，與本季已實現財務分開。
text.en: CNA's November 11 report gives Q3 sales of NT$9.787 billion, attributable profit of NT$1.08 billion, and gross margin of 25.65%, down 4.12 points YoY and 2.77 points QoQ. Nine-month attributable profit was NT$3.213 billion, up 95.6% YoY. Earlier guidance for end-year platform shipments remains separate from these realized financials.

text.zh: 液冷散熱系統獨立營收、機櫃瓦數、各客戶驗收、對應伺服器平台數量與毛利變化的分項原因未公開。
text.en: Standalone liquid-cooling sales, rack power loads, customer acceptance, platform quantities and product-level explanations for margin changes remain unreported.

title.zh: 追蹤：漢測第三季認列 11.18 億元員工認股費用，歸母虧損 2.86 億元
title.en: Follow-up: Hermes Testing books NT$1.118B employee-share expense, posts NT$286M Q3 attributable loss

summary.zh: 漢測 11 月 11 日公布第三季合併營收約 15 億元，因認列上市櫃前員工認股的一次性非現金費用約 11.18 億元，第三季歸屬母公司淨損約 2.86 億元、每股虧損 10.23 元。公司指出這項費用估計影響每股純益約 32.58 元，但尚未提供完整可核對的調整後獲利報表；前三季整體仍獲利 2.98 億元。
summary.en: Hermes Testing reported Q3 consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.5 billion on November 11 but booked about NT$1.118 billion in one-off noncash employee share-subscription expense before listing, resulting in an attributable loss of roughly NT$286 million and a loss per share of NT$10.23. Management estimated a per-share effect of NT$32.58 from the expense but did not publish a fully reconciled adjusted profit statement; nine-month profit remained NT$298 million.

text.zh: 漢測提供晶圓測試熱管理、MEMS 探針卡、清潔材料及工程服務，與前次已發布的 10 月營收新聞屬不同報表期間。上市櫃前員工股權費用在會計帳上認列，不直接代表當季實際現金支出，評估獲利時仍須使用公司正式列報數字。
text.en: Hermes Testing supplies wafer-test thermal control, MEMS probe cards, cleaning products and engineering services; this quarterly financial disclosure differs from the earlier October sales update. Pre-listing equity compensation expense is noncash but remains recognized under reported accounting, and any adjusted earnings must be formally reconciled.

text.zh: 中央社 11 月 11 日報導漢測第三季營收約 15 億元、營業虧損 2.88 億元、歸母虧損 2.86 億元、基本每股虧損 10.23 元。員工認股一次性費用約 11.18 億元，公司估計對第三季 EPS 影響 32.58 元，該估計不可直接視為依正式會計準則公布的調整後 EPS。前三季合併營收 36.85 億元、年增 129.06%，毛利率 47.83%，歸母淨利 2.98 億元。
text.en: CNA reported Q3 sales of about NT$1.5 billion, operating loss NT$288 million, attributable loss NT$286 million and reported loss per share NT$10.23. The one-off employee subscription cost was NT$1.118 billion, which management estimated reduced EPS by NT$32.58; this does not constitute a formally reconciled adjusted EPS. Nine-month sales were NT$3.685 billion, up 129.06% YoY, with gross margin 47.83% and attributable profit NT$298 million.

title.en: Cheng Mei Materials discloses packaging tape qualification, targets initial shipments in H2 2027

summary.zh: 誠美材 11 月 12 日法說會表示，晶圓切割膠帶及研磨保護膜材已向台灣封裝業者送樣，現階段仍在客戶驗證，預計 2027 年下半年至 2028 年逐步交付，現階段仍在客戶驗證。公司第三季合併營收 18.61 億元、稅後淨損 2.35 億元，尚無半導體材料獨立量產收入。
summary.en: At its November 12 investor briefing, Cheng Mei Materials said dicing tapes and wafer-grinding protective films are in customer qualification with Taiwanese packaging firms, targeting initial shipments between H2 2027 and 2028, subject to customer qualification, while Q3 consolidated sales were NT$1.861 billion and the net loss was NT$235 million; no separate semiconductor-material revenue was disclosed.

text.zh: 誠美材原有偏光片及光學薄膜業務，正將膜材製造技術延伸到晶圓切割、研磨保護等封裝流程。材料送樣驗證通常涉及可靠度及製程相容性，與已通過量產資格、取得大批採購合約屬不同階段。
text.en: Cheng Mei Materials historically produces polarizing and optical films and is adapting film-making techniques to wafer dicing and grinding protection. Samples undergoing reliability and process compatibility testing are not yet volume-qualified or contracted production.

text.zh: 11 月 12 日法說揭露封裝應用膜材正在台灣客戶驗證，管理階層表示至少須數月驗證並進行導入，預期 2027 年下半年才可能小量出貨。時報新聞報導第三季合併營收 18.61 億元、季減 9.2%、年減 13.8%，毛利率負 0.1%，稅後淨損 2.35 億元；財務數字為既有整體業務。
text.en: Management said on November 12 that packaging films were being qualified by customers in Taiwan and might begin limited deliveries in H2 2027 after several months of testing. The China Times financial report gave Q3 revenue of NT$1.861 billion, down 9.2% QoQ and 13.8% YoY, gross margin of minus 0.1% and a net loss of NT$235 million, figures covering the entire company.

text.en: Packaging customer identities, qualification standards, final acceptance dates, monthly material output and semiconductor-business revenue remain unknown.

title.zh: 立凱電與北美業者簽 LFP 材料合作備忘錄，擬於台灣試產年產 2.5 萬噸產線
title.en: Aleees signs LFP cathode MOU with North American partner, proposes 25,000-ton Taiwan pilot capacity

summary.zh: 磷酸鐵鋰正極材料商立凱電 11 月 11 日與未具名北美業者簽署合作備忘錄，計畫在台灣成立合資公司，規劃年產 2.5 萬公噸 LFP 正極材料生產線以進行試產及客戶認證。備忘錄自 11 月 11 日起為期一年，出資比例、投資額及合作條款尚待正式協議，美國後續廠房亦取決於必要核准及客戶認證。
summary.en: On November 11, LFP cathode maker Aleees signed a one-year memorandum of understanding with an unnamed North American counterparty to explore a Taiwan joint venture and a planned 25,000-tonne annual LFP cathode production line for pilot batches and customer qualification. Ownership ratios, capex and binding terms require later agreements, while potential US production depends on approvals and customer acceptance.

text.zh: LFP 正極材料用於鋰離子電池製造，與工業電力備援及終端儲能應用有產品層級關聯，但本次未揭露資料中心 BBU 的具名客戶或銷售合約。立凱電表示將先完成台灣試產與認證，再討論北美擴產，不能將兩地規劃視為已建產能。
text.en: LFP cathode materials feed lithium-ion battery manufacturing with potential uses in industrial backup power and energy storage. The MOU names no data-center BBU customer or sales contract. Aleees described Taiwan pilot qualification before considering US production, and neither proposed line is existing capacity.

text.zh: 中央社於 11 月 12 日報導，雙方備忘錄自 11 月 11 日起一年，可經書面同意展延。台灣規劃年產 2.5 萬公噸，後續美國大規模商業化生產須待目標客戶驗收及法規核可；公司前三季歸屬母公司淨損 3.21 億元，財務實績與新合作計畫應分開。
text.en: CNA reported that the memorandum runs for one year from November 11, extendable by written agreement. The Taiwan target is 25,000 metric tonnes per year, while US commercial production depends on customer qualification and permits. Aleees' nine-month attributable loss of NT$321 million is a financial actual separate from the proposed venture.

text.zh: 北美合作方名稱、台灣合資契約、最終資本支出、年產能建置時間、LFP 客戶驗收及美國廠場址未公布。
text.en: North American counterparty, binding joint-venture agreement, capital budget, line construction timing, LFP customer acceptance and US plant site are not disclosed.

question.zh: 鴻海第三季營收能換算成 AI 機櫃出貨量嗎？
question.en: Can Foxconn's Q3 revenue be converted into AI rack shipments?

text.zh: 鴻海公布合併營收及雲端網路事業占比，但沒有分列 AI 機櫃台數與產品售價。第四季及 2027 年高雙位數出貨成長均屬公司預測。
text.en: Foxconn published consolidated revenue and a cloud-networking share but no distinct rack units or average rack prices. High-double-digit rack growth in Q4 and 2027 is guidance.

question.zh: 三井金屬新廠的 1,900 億日圓和生產設備費能直接相加嗎？
question.en: Should Mitsui's JPY190B total be added to its equipment cost?

text.zh: 不能。1,900 億日圓已含土地約 140 億、建築約 320 億及設備等約 1,440 億日圓，三項分配相加即為總額，產能仍是 2031 年後規劃。
text.en: No. The JPY190B total includes JPY14B land, JPY32B buildings and JPY144B equipment/other assets. The components already sum to the total, with capacity planned from 2031 onward.

question.zh: 漢測第三季虧損應直接加回一次性員工認股費用嗎？
question.en: Should Hermes' one-off employee-share expense simply be added back to earnings?

text.zh: 不宜自行加回作為正式淨利。公司公布的一次性非現金費用和每股影響估計，尚未構成完整的稅後、股數調整及會計口徑一致的調整後財報。
text.en: A mechanical add-back is not a formal adjusted profit figure. The disclosed noncash cost and estimated EPS effect lack a full tax, share-count and accounting reconciliation.

text.zh: 三井金屬正式銅箔新廠公告日期為 11 月 10 日，仍在本期 72 小時內；三福化與南亞董事會資本支出日期為 11 月 11 日，後續媒體於 11 月 12 日報導。不同日期不能視為同一天新增的投資核准。
text.en: Mitsui's copper-foil approval is dated November 10 and falls within the 72-hour coverage window. Nanya and San Fu approved capex November 11, with follow-up reporting November 12. They were not all newly approved on the same day.

verificationNote.zh: 鴻海第三季實績依公司原始英文新聞稿及中央社詳細數字核對，部分分項金額以公司公布精度呈現。南亞及三福化董事會案仍為投資核准，產能尚未實現；三福化重大訊息透過媒體轉載取得。馬來西亞 GPU 監管僅有部長構想，尚無立法條文，個別業者指控未獲裁判確認。三井金屬馬來西亞新廠公告日期為 11 月 10 日，設備及土地建築成本已含在總投資額內，2031 年後產能仍屬計畫。雙鴻毛利比較、漢測員工認股費用、誠美材封裝材料驗證與立凱電 LFP 合作均依公司及二手報導口徑，未對未公布獲利、出貨或正式合約自行推算。
verificationNote.en: Foxconn Q3 figures were checked against its original English release and CNA's detailed figures, retaining original rounding. Nanya and San Fu approvals are budgets rather than commissioned capacity, and San Fu's filing was inspected through a reproduction. Malaysia's GPU oversight remains a ministerial idea without enacted text; allegations about individual firms are not adjudicated facts. Mitsui's announcement is dated November 10 and its land, buildings and equipment costs are included in its total, with capacity due after 2031. Auras' margin comparison, Hermes' one-off expense, Cheng Mei's film qualification and Aleees' LFP MOU follow attributed disclosures without inventing adjusted profits, shipments or binding agreements.
